boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Arkansas
boards.description: Ten currently documented Fayetteville food destinations with late or overnight availability; confirm holiday exceptions before leaving.

cards.title: Waffle House #439
cards.subtitle: 2311 W. Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd., Fayetteville
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm service before heading out; this MLK Boulevard diner lists round-the-clock hours every day.
cards.short_summary: An around-the-clock diner option on Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Waffle House lists its Fayetteville #439 location at 2311 W. MLK Blvd. as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 24-hour operation Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: IHOP on W. Wedington Drive
cards.subtitle: 3153 W. Wedington Dr., Fayetteville
cards.notes: Plan for dine-in, takeout, curbside, or delivery; the restaurant page identifies this Fayetteville location as a 24-hour late-night-food option.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour pancake-house option west of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists its 3153 W. Wedington Dr. Fayetteville restaurant as open 24 hours daily, with dine-in, takeout, curbside, delivery, and late-night food.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant hours as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.

cards.title: Whataburger at Hwy. 62 & Sang
cards.subtitle: 1956 W. Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd., Fayetteville
cards.notes: Check the location’s service mode before going; Whataburger’s Fayetteville listing identifies this MLK Boulevard restaurant as open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Whataburger location on Martin Luther King Jr. Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger lists restaurant #1086 at 1956 W. Martin Luther King Blvd. in Fayetteville as open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: Official Fayetteville location listing says this restaurant is open 24 hours; holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: Whataburger at Hwy. 71 & Joyce
cards.subtitle: 4030 N. College Ave., Fayetteville
cards.notes: Use this north College Avenue location when an overnight option fits the route; its official page lists both dine-in and drive-thru at 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour Whataburger at North College Avenue and Joyce Boulevard.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger lists restaurant #1100 at 4030 N. College Ave. with 24-hour dine-in, drive-thru, and delivery every day.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists dine-in and drive-thru as 24 hours daily; holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: Pickleman's on Dickson Street
cards.subtitle: 410 W. Dickson St., Fayetteville
cards.notes: Order ahead or walk in near the arts district; the location page posts midnight closing Sunday through Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A toasted-sandwich and pizza stop with late Dickson Street hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pickleman's lists its 410 W. Dickson St. Fayetteville cafe open until midnight Sunday through Wednesday and until 3 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: 10 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Wednesday; 10 a.m.–3 a.m. Thursday–Saturday.

cards.title: Taqueria Lucha
cards.subtitle: 412 W. Dickson St., Fayetteville
cards.notes: Save this for Thursday through Saturday evenings: the restaurant’s own page posts a 6 p.m. to 3 a.m. schedule and direct ordering.
cards.short_summary: A Dickson Street taco destination operating late on select nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Taqueria Lucha lists its Fayetteville location at 412 W. Dickson St. as open Thursday through Saturday from 6 p.m. to 3 a.m.
cards.access_notes: Official hours show Thursday–Saturday, 6 p.m.–3 a.m.; closed Sunday–Wednesday.

cards.title: PLOMO Quesadillas on Dickson
cards.subtitle: 644 W. Dickson St., Fayetteville
cards.notes: Choose the Dickson Street branch for the latest PLOMO hours; its official location page posts 3 a.m. closing on Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A quesadilla-focused option with 3 a.m. hours on select nights.
cards.evidence_claim: PLOMO lists its 644 W. Dickson St. Fayetteville restaurant open until 3 a.m. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official hours: 11 a.m.–3 a.m. Thursday, Friday, and Saturday; 11 a.m.–10 p.m. other listed days.

cards.title: PLOMO Quesadillas on MLK
cards.subtitle: 2016 Martin Luther King Jr. Blvd., Fayetteville
cards.notes: Use the MLK Boulevard branch for a midnight food stop; the official page lists midnight closing every day and offers direct ordering.
cards.short_summary: A separate PLOMO location with nightly midnight hours.
cards.evidence_claim: PLOMO lists its 2016 MLK Jr Blvd. Fayetteville restaurant open from 11 a.m. until midnight every day.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list 11 a.m.–midnight Sunday through Saturday.

cards.title: Rude Awakening Coffee House
cards.subtitle: Downtown Fayetteville
cards.notes: Make Friday or Saturday the late visit: the coffee house’s official site lists midnight closing on those nights and describes its downtown location.
cards.short_summary: A downtown coffee-house stop with midnight weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Rude Awakening Coffee House lists Friday and Saturday hours of 7:30 a.m. to midnight at its downtown Fayetteville location.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Friday and Saturday hours as 7:30 a.m.–midnight.

cards.title: Big Whiskey's on North College
cards.subtitle: 1320 N. College Ave., Fayetteville
cards.notes: For a seated late meal, check the official hours before departing; this full-service restaurant lists midnight close most nights and 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A North College Avenue restaurant open through midnight or later.
cards.evidence_claim: Big Whiskey's lists its Fayetteville restaurant at 1320 N. College Ave. open until midnight Sunday through Thursday and until 1 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Big Whiskey's American Restaurant & Bar — Fayetteville
cards.access_notes: Official hours: 11 a.m.–midnight Sunday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–1 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Verify service availability before visiting.
